description_en: Shares an image with other Alibaba Cloud accounts, or unshares an image from the recipient Alibaba Cloud accounts
description_zh: 将镜像共享给无影的其他用户或者取消已经共享的镜像
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-image-permission --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-gx2x1dhsmusr20000 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyImagePermission

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of Alibaba Cloud accounts to which to share the image that will be created based on the image template. You can specify up to 20 account IDs
parameters.help_zh: 接受镜像共享的阿里云账号ID。可共享给1~50个阿里云账号
parameters.name: add_account

parameters.help_en: The ID of Alibaba Cloud account N from which you want to unshare the custom image. Valid values of N: 1 to 10. If the value of N is greater than 10, this parameter is ignored
parameters.help_zh: 取消镜像共享的阿里云账号ID。可取消共享给1~50个阿里云账号
parameters.name: remove_account
